limitations: Development verification is not official evaluation; official correctness remains unevaluated.
The original specification gives no power-up state or X/Z input semantics; binary functional tests begin with synchronous load.
implementation: Eight explicitly widened neighbour bits are summed per cell with modulo-16 row and column wrap; all next cells derive from the current q. Rising-edge load has priority over evolution.
verification: Independent offset-loop oracle based on the original problem; all neighbour counts for live/dead interior and corner cells, empty/full states, successive loads, wrapped oscillator and stable block, every isolated cell, random multicycle trajectories, and checks for no updates between positive edges.
